title: Cortex — Real-Time Multiplayer Quiz Platform
description: Because studying alone is boring. Built a platform that turns notes into AI-generated quizzes you can play with friends. Behind the scenes, it's Redis, background workers, synchronized game state, and a lot of making sure everything happens at the right time.

title: Graph Analysis Automation — Schneider Prize Winner
description: Scientists have better things to do than stare at thousands of CSV files. Built a tool for MRG Labs researchers that compares spectra, spots oxidation patterns, and processes 100,000+ data points in seconds.

title: Campus Ride Sharing App
description: Somewhere on campus, two people are probably driving to the same place and don't know it. Built a ride-sharing platform that connects them using location, timing, and preferences, with real-time messaging and scheduling.

title: foot-steps
description: Turns trip photos into a map and timeline using photo metadata and landmark detection.

title: Inhibitor
description: Hides YouTube's rabbit holes so you can finish what you came to do.

title: Cinemas
description: Keeps movie showtimes and screenings organized without the spreadsheet chaos.

title: Hennest
description: Tracks spending, goals, and alerts so the budget stops being a guessing game.
